name: Interchange
tag: Draw the transit lines of a growing city and keep everyone moving
title: Interchange

text.TAG: Draw the transit lines of a growing city. Get every passenger where they want to go before a station overflows
text.FREE: Endless city: build your network as the city grows. Turn on relaxed mode to play without a game over
text.WATCH: A tour of busy networks in four neon cities
text.FOOT: Every week you get a new train and choose an upgrade. Passengers want a kind of place, not a station: they change lines to get there.
text.FIND: Find a station, line or upgrade…
text.HINT: Drag from a station to another to draw a line · drag from a line's end to extend it · right-drag to look around
